newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.

Front page editorial calls for Communist Party to rally round party chief Jiang Zemin. Editorial coincides with conclusion of major television series extolling Deng's contributions to building a modern China.
Paper heaps praise on television series on life of Deng Xiaoping.
Front page commentary says China unlikely to cut interest rates again soon.
China tightens grip on banks' handling of large deposits to eliminate fraud.
Futures experts say China may revive trading of commodities such as long grain rice. They say commodities markets need further standardisation.
Bank of China posts domestic profits of 8.2 billion yuan in 1996. Assets said to be 1.8199 trillion yuan as of end of last year.
The Ministry of Finance outlines task of curbing irregularities in state spending in 1997.
The Agricultural Bank of China posts profits of 518 million yuan in 1996.
China National Nuclear Power corp says it sees major gains in four nuclear power projects this year, including completion of project for Pakistan.
